Description: Infection of susceptible humans by infectious mosquitoes, at a rate determined by the force of infection (L).
Progression from the exposed (pre-patent) stage to clinical disease (with probability w).
Progression from the exposed (pre-patent) stage to patent asymptomatic infection (with probability 1-w).
Successful treatment of clinical disease (with probability fT).
Clearance of untreated clinical disease to patent asymptomatic infection (with rate rD, for those who fail treatment 1-fT).
Entry into a period of prophylactic protection after successful treatment (with rate rT).
Loss of prophylactic protection, returning to the susceptible state (with rate rP).
Progression from patent asymptomatic infection to sub-patent asymptomatic infection (at rate rA).
Clearance of sub-patent infection, returning to the fully susceptible state (at rate rU).
Infection of susceptible mosquitoes by infectious humans upon taking an infectious bite.
Progression from the latent (exposed) state to the infectious state in mosquitoes.

Name: L
Description: Force of infection in the human population, determined by vector-to-human ratio, mosquito biting rate, proportion of infectious mosquitoes, and human anti-infection immunity.

Name: w
Description: Probability of developing clinical disease upon infection, determined by anti-disease immunity.

Name: fT
Description: Fixed probability of successful treatment for clinical disease.

Name: rT
Description: Rate of entering prophylactic protection after successful treatment.

Name: rP
Description: Rate of returning to the susceptible state from prophylactic protection.

Name: rD
Description: Rate of clearing untreated clinical disease and becoming patently asymptomatic.

Name: rA
Description: Rate of moving from patent asymptomatic infection to sub-patent asymptomatic infection, dependent on anti-parasite immunity.

Name: rU
Description: Rate of clearing sub-patent infection and returning to the susceptible state.

Name: EIR
Description: Entomological Inoculation Rate, representing the intensity of transmission in different settings.
Unit: ibppy (infectious bites per person per year)

Name: DDT half-life
Description: Half-life of DDT insecticide used in Indoor Residual Spraying (IRS).

Name: RTS,S vaccine efficacy half-life
Description: Half-life of the pre-erythrocytic vaccine (RTS,S) efficacy.

Name: ACT prophylactic protection duration
Description: Duration of prophylactic protection provided by Artemisinin-based Combination Therapies (ACTs).

Name: LLIN insecticide efficacy half-life
Description: Half-life of the insecticidal effect and wear-and-tear for Long-Lasting Insecticide-treated Nets (LLINs).
